critical_finding_summary.headline: The producer's headline defect claim is independently confirmed true, with zero discrepancies found across the full package.
critical_finding_summary.detail: Historical ledger/evidence/EV-SIG-007.yaml@fed33c0986e64f2af1fc989931d8c37ef6aa3ef5 contains a YAML body whose id: field reads EV-SIG-007 but whose full content and sha256 (fca156654bbfa3fd0839576454cbd184c074d08ef0882b31c54bde65258232f9) match exactly what source-git-evidence.json's own pre-existing declaration attributes to ledger/evidence/EV-SIG-010.yaml at that same commit. No EV-SIG-010.yaml blob exists in that commit's tree at all (confirmed by both git show failure and git ls-tree structural absence). The current on-disk EV-SIG-010.yaml is byte-identical to the mislabeled fed33c0 blob except for the id: field. This reviewer re-ran every one of these checks with its own fresh git invocations rather than trusting the producer's transcription, and every one of the producer's 12 package entries, both cited commit/parent pairs, and the coordinator's snapshot commit's own declared path_sha256 were found to be exactly as reported.
